capabilities: Read RSS, Atom, and podcast feeds in a native Obsidian reader view
Subscribe to and manage feeds with grouping, renaming, and OPML import/export
Switch articles between original, Chinese translation, and Qiaomu AI rewrite versions
Append article links and selected excerpts to the Daily Note or current note
Read vault Markdown folders as channels with native Obsidian rendering
disambiguation: Despite the AI in its name, it only displays AI rewrites and translations pre-generated by the Qiaomu service and never requests new AI generation or sends notes to model providers.
extras: Licensed GPL-3.0-only. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+. Markdown/PDF export is desktop-only. Installable via BRAT or manual download; the manifest notes it has not yet been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Limits: 2,000 personal feeds, 50 articles per feed, 64 MB image cache. Feed URLs with private tokens are stored unencrypted in plugin data and OPML exports.
intentEvidence: 它不是其他 Obsidian RSS 插件的 fork。
problem: Obsidian has no built-in feed reader, so reading subscriptions and capturing article links or excerpts into notes requires leaving the vault.

relations.evidence: 本插件参考自有 QMReader iOS 的产品交互，根据 QMReader 服务 的公共 API 独立开发。
装了乔木Home时，主页显示最新未读文章与未读数，主页搜索框也能搜到文章
Qiaomu Audio is optional. Both plugins can read independently; when installed together they pause each other on playback.
